newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Buckeye taps banks for loan backing Merfin buy.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Buckeye taps banks for loan backing Merfin buy.

text.p: NEW YORK, April 23 (LPC) - Fleet Financial Group's Fleet Bank, SunTrust Banks Inc and Toronto-Dominion Bank have launched a fully underwritten $275 million loan for Buckeye Cellulose Corp, market sources said.
Fleet Bank will act as administrative agent and arranger, while SunTrust and Toronto-Dominion will act as documentation agents. The firms will underwrite fully the loan, the sources said.
The credit backs the company's acquisition of Vancouver-based Merfin International Inc, a maker of specialty fabrics used in feminine hygiene products.
The loan removes a $155 million facility put in place by Fleet in November 1995.

Pricing on the five-year revolving credit starts at 75 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate, with a 22.5 basis point commitment fee, at the company's current rating of BB+/Ba1, according to bankers.
Pricing on the deal is tied to borrower ratings or financial performance, whichever is more favorable to the company, bankers added.
